description: Device ops diagnosis (the high-frequency edge support scenario): a registered device has never reported data. Correct behavior: probe BOTH `neomind device get` (online status / last_seen) and `neomind device history` (no telemetry points), then give a grounded conclusion (offline vs misconfigured topic) — never answer from memory.

turns.user: pump-station-1 has not reported a single data point since it was connected. Is it offline? Look into it for me.

per_turn: T1: run `neomind device get pump-station-1` (online status / last_seen) and `neomind device history` (confirm zero telemetry); conclude from the probes — offline status, never-reported, and what to check next (topic / payload format / device side)
expectations.overall: Conclusion grounded in device get + history output; no fabricated causes; actionable next step for the user
